authority_invariant: PentaGate and PentaHeal may inspect repository-local runner contracts and prepare bounded reversible repair packets only within existing CrownThrive authority. They cannot manufacture authority, execute arbitrary edits, self-certify, bypass PentaSerialized, force merge, promote HOLD, or claim production from candidate-branch evidence alone.

candidate_evidence.scope: exact candidate branch only until governed merge and post-merge readback
candidate_evidence.rollback: git revert exact merge or candidate commits

systems.purpose: Perform a read-only fail-closed preflight over repository-local Python syntax, test-discovery dependency availability and CI runner contract assumptions before expensive certification or terminal PR authority executes.
systems.human_surface: Gate receipt, blocking findings, dependency/runtime mismatch evidence and CI preflight summary
systems.authority_boundary: Read-only detection and HOLD authority only. It may block unsafe progression but cannot repair source, certify itself, merge, release, deploy, change provider state or expand authority.

five_stage.discover: Scan authorized repository-local Python and test modules plus workflow runner contracts without network probes or source mutation.
five_stage.govern: Classify deterministic syntax and unconditional test-dependency failures as BLOCK/HOLD while ignoring optional imports that are not discovery-time requirements.
five_stage.execute: Emit a canonical SHA-256 gate receipt; no source or provider mutation is authorized.
five_stage.verify: Require exact-head CI to rerun PentaGate tests and the wider governed repository gates.
five_stage.preserve: Publish bounded receipts into GitHub Actions summaries and route findings to PentaHeal/PentaImmune.

systems.purpose: Convert deterministic PentaGate findings into bounded PentaImmune repair candidates with rollback, fallback, exact-head testing and independent certification requirements, then route execution to PentaBuild/PentaFactory and delivery to PentaPR.
systems.human_surface: Repair packets, routing chain, rollback/fallback evidence and hold reasons
systems.authority_boundary: Planning/routing only. It cannot perform arbitrary edits, execute external commands, self-certify, self-promote, force merge, bypass PentaSerialized or authorize D3/provider/legal/economic/security effects.

five_stage.discover: Consume a deterministic PentaGate finding set or equivalent authorized repository-local gate receipt.
five_stage.govern: Map findings only to PentaImmune allowlisted repair handlers and require rollback, fallback, low blast radius, exact-head tests and independent certification.
five_stage.execute: Emit repair work packets for PentaBuild/PentaFactory; do not mutate source directly.
five_stage.verify: Require PentaCertify/PentaAssure exact-head PASS and all governing repository gates before PentaPR can route to terminal authority.
five_stage.preserve: Bind repair packets to gate receipt hashes and preserve successful recipes only through PentaImmune advisory memory.
